name: Dify
description: Dify is an open-source large language model (LLM) application development platform. It combines the concepts of Backend-as-a-Service and LLMOps to enable developers to quickly build production-grade generative AI applications. Even non-technical personnel can participate in the definition and data operations of AI applications.

questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  config:
    container_name: dify-config
    restart: unless-stopped
    image: ns2kracy/dify-config:latest
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/nginx
        target: /configs/nginx
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/ssrf_proxy
        target: /configs/ssrf_proxy
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/sandbox
        target: /configs/sandbox
    networks:
      - dify
  api:
    image: langgenius/dify-api:0.15.8
    container_name: dify-api
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MODE: api
      LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY}
      CONSOLE_WEB_URL: ""
      INIT_PASSWORD: ""
      CONSOLE_API_URL: ""
      SERVICE_API_URL: ""
      APP_WEB_URL: ""
      FILES_URL: ""
      FILES_ACCESS_TIMEOUT: "300"
      MIGRATION_ENABLED: "true"
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_DATABASE: dify
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      REDIS_DB: "0"
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: redis://:${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}@redis:6379/1
      WEB_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS: "*"
      CONSOLE_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS: "*"
      STORAGE_TYPE: local
      STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH: storage
      VECTOR_STORE: weaviate
      WEAVIATE_ENDPOINT: http://weaviate:8080
      WEAVIATE_API_KEY: ${SECRET_WEAVIATE_API_KEY}
      CODE_EXECUTION_ENDPOINT: "http://sandbox:8194"
      CODE_EXECUTION_API_KEY: ${SECRET_CODE_EXECUTION_API_KEY}
      CODE_MAX_NUMBER: "9223372036854775807"
      CODE_MIN_NUMBER: "-9223372036854775808"
      CODE_MAX_STRING_LENGTH: "80000"
      TEMPLATE_TRANSFORM_MAX_LENGTH: "80000"
      CODE_MAX_STRING_ARRAY_LENGTH: "30"
      CODE_MAX_OBJECT_ARRAY_LENGTH: "30"
      CODE_MAX_NUMBER_ARRAY_LENGTH: "1000"
      SSRF_PROXY_HTTP_URL: "http://ssrf_proxy:3128"
      SSRF_PROXY_HTTPS_URL: "http://ssrf_proxy:3128"
      INDEXING_MAX_SEGMENTATION_TOKENS_LENGTH: "1000"
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/app/api/storage:/app/api/storage
    networks:
      - ssrf_proxy_network
      - dify
  worker:
    image: langgenius/dify-api:0.15.8
    container_name: dify-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MODE: worker
      LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY}
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_DATABASE: dify
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      REDIS_DB: "0"
      REDIS_USE_SSL: "false"
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: redis://:${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}@redis:6379/1
      STORAGE_TYPE: local
      STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH: storage
      VECTOR_STORE: weaviate
      WEAVIATE_ENDPOINT: http://weaviate:8080
      WEAVIATE_API_KEY: ${SECRET_WEAVIATE_API_KEY}
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/app/api/storage:/app/api/storage
    networks:
      - ssrf_proxy_network
      - dify
  web:
    image: langgenius/dify-web:0.15.8
    container_name: dify-web
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CONSOLE_API_URL: ""
      APP_API_URL: ""
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 2048M
    networks:
      - dify
  db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: dify-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PGUSER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: dify
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    command: >
      postgres -c 'max_connections=100'

               -c 'shared_buffers=128MB'
               -c 'work_mem=4MB'
               -c 'maintenance_work_mem=64MB'
               -c 'effective_cache_size=4096MB'
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/db/data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready"]
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
    networks:
      - dify
  redis:
    image: redis:6-alpine
    container_name: dify-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      REDISCLI_AUTH: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/redis/data:/data
    command: redis-server --requirepass ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'redis-cli', 'ping']
    networks:
      - dify
  weaviate:
    image: semitechnologies/weaviate:1.19.0
    container_name: dify-weaviate
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/weaviate:/var/lib/weaviate
    environment:
      QUERY_DEFAULTS_LIMIT: "25"
      AUTHENTICATION_ANONYMOUS_ACCESS_ENABLED: "false"
      PERSISTENCE_DATA_PATH: /var/lib/weaviate
      DEFAULT_VECTORIZER_MODULE: none
      CLUSTER_HOSTNAME: node1
      AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_ENABLED: "true"
      AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_ALLOWED_KEYS: ${SECRET_WEAVIATE_API_KEY}
      AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_USERS: ${SECRET_AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_USERS}
      AUTHORIZATION_ADMINLIST_ENABLED: "true"
      AUTHORIZATION_ADMINLIST_USERS: hello@dify.ai
    networks:
      - dify
  sandbox:
    image: langgenius/dify-sandbox:0.2.11
    container_name: dify-sandbox
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      API_KEY: ${SECRET_CODE_EXECUTION_API_KEY}
      GIN_MODE: release
      WORKER_TIMEOUT: "15"
      ENABLE_NETWORK: "true"
      HTTP_PROXY: "http://ssrf_proxy:3128"
      HTTPS_PROXY: "http://ssrf_proxy:3128"
      SANDBOX_PORT: "8194"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/sandbox/dependencies:/dependencies
    networks:
      - ssrf_proxy_network
    depends_on:
      - config
  ssrf_proxy:
    image: ubuntu/squid:latest
    container_name: dify-ssrf_proxy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      HTTP_PORT: 3128
      COREDUMP_DIR: /var/spool/squid
      REVERSE_PROXY_PORT: 8194
      SANDBOX_HOST: sandbox
      SANDBOX_PORT: 8194
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/ssrf_proxy:/etc/squid
    networks:
      - ssrf_proxy_network
      - dify
    depends_on:
      - config
  nginx:
    image: nginx:latest
    container_name: dify-nginx
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/nginx:/etc/nginx
    depends_on:
      - api
      - web
      - config
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    networks:
      - dify
networks:
  ssrf_proxy_network:
    driver: bridge
    internal: true
  dify:
    name: dify
